Special Features - 5 Merino Drive, Stoneyford
•	Substantial five-bedroom detached bungalow extending to approximately 1,500 sq. ft., offering excellent space, 
         flexibility and family accommodation.
•	Superb location in the heart of Stoneyford Village, one of Kilkenny’s most convenient and well-established village communities. 
        Approximately 15 minutes’ drive from Kilkenny City, with easy access to Junctions 9 and 10 of the M9 motorway.
•	Excellent potential for multi-generational living – the existing layout could readily lend itself to a main residence with 
        separate granny flat/independent living accommodation, subject to any necessary works or permissions.
•	Five double bedrooms, all benefiting from built-in wardrobe storage.  Two separate reception rooms, 
        providing excellent flexibility for family living, entertaining or working from home.
•	Private, secure and west-facing rear garden, ideal for families and benefiting from excellent afternoon and evening sunshine.  
        Attractive outdoor space incorporating a lawn and cobblelock patio, ideal for outdoor dining, entertaining and children’s play.
•	Bright and character-filled kitchen/dining room with pine fitted units, large roof window and a 
        Stanley stove set within an attractive red-brick chimney breast
•	Generous rear living room with timber flooring, ceiling cornicing and solid-fuel stove with marble fireplace surround.
•	Charming dual-aspect front sitting room featuring ceiling cornicing, built-in display cabinetry and a mirrored fireplace with electric insert.
•	Two modern shower rooms, both finished to a high standard, including a fully modernised main shower room presented in showroom condition.
•	Substantial detached garage/outbuilding providing valuable additional space and excellent future potential.  
        Detached garage includes a remote-controlled roller door, adjoining fully fitted utility area with extensive storage and a separate fuel store.
•	Generous tarmacadam driveway providing secure off-street parking for up to four cars. 
        Fully walled front boundary with separate vehicular and pedestrian entrance gates, lawn and mature planting.
•	Excellent village amenities close by, including school, doctor’s surgery, church, community centre, playing pitch, 
        walking track and children’s playground.
•	Convenient to the renowned Mount Juliet Estate and Golf Club.
•	A well-maintained and highly versatile property offering the rare combination of five-bedroom accommodation, 
        extensive parking, private gardens and substantial outbuildings in a mature village setting.


5 Merino Drive is a substantial five-bedroom detached bungalow, superbly positioned in the heart of Stoneyford village. The location is one of the key strengths of this home. Stoneyford is a vibrant and well-serviced village with a strong community atmosphere and a wide range of amenities close at hand, including school, church and doctors surgery. The community centre, grass pitch, walking track and children’s play area are all nearby, along with local sports and activity groups. Kilkenny city centre is approximately a 15-minute drive away, while Junctions 9 and 10 of the M9 are within easy reach, providing excellent connectivity. The renowned Mount Juliet Estate and Golf Club are also within close proximity.
The property is fully walled to the front, with both vehicular and pedestrian entrance gates. A generous tarmacadam driveway provides secure off-street parking for up to four cars. The front garden is neatly laid in lawn and bordered by mature shrubs and flowering plants, creating an attractive and welcoming first impression. To the rear, the sunny west-facing garden is private, mature and secure, making it ideal for children, & outdoor dining and entertaining. This area has a neat lawn, and a cobblelock patio area.
Internally, the accommodation extends to approximately 1,500 sq. ft. and is exceptionally well laid out. The spacious entrance hallway sets the tone for the home, with a beautiful timber floor and a bright, welcoming feel. To the right, a modern timber and glazed door opens into the front sitting room. This is a charming reception space with a dual-aspect outlook, carpet flooring, ceiling cornicing and a striking mirrored fireplace with electric insert. Built-in display cabinets on either side of the fireplace add character to the room.
Off the main hallway are three double bedrooms, each fitted with built-in wardrobes with a lovely family finish to all. A fully modernised shower room, presented in showroom condition, is positioned centrally to serve all 3 bedrooms. This area of the home is practical, comfortable and well suited to family living or guest accommodation.
To the rear of the property is a second living room, again finished with timber flooring and ceiling cornicing. This is a generous and comfortable everyday living space, featuring a marble fireplace surround with a solid fuel stove insert. From here, a door leads directly into the kitchen and dining area.


The kitchen is a warm and inviting space, fitted with pine kitchen units, tiled flooring and a distinctive red brick chimney breast feature housing a Stanley stove. A large roof window floods the room with natural light, creating a bright and sociable kitchen-dining area with oozing character.
A small corridor off the kitchen leads to two further double bedrooms, both with built-in wardrobes, along with a second shower room/WC. This bathroom is again finished to a very high standard, tiled from floor to ceiling and presented in immaculate condition. A door from this corridor also provides access to the outside, adding further practicality to the layout. The property could easily be broken into a main house and granny flat.
To the rear and slightly set apart from the main residence is a substantial detached outbuilding, currently divided into a garage and a fully equipped utility space. The garage benefits from a remote roller door, while the adjoining utility room is fitted with extensive storage units and a single drainer sink. A further door gives access to a fuel shed running behind the garage. This building offers excellent flexibility and has clear potential for use as a workshop, games room, hobby space, home gym or additional storage area, subject to your own requirements.
Overall, 5 Merino Drive is a spacious, well-maintained and highly versatile detached bungalow in a mature village setting. With five bedrooms, two reception rooms, two modern shower rooms, excellent outdoor space, generous parking and valuable outbuildings, it represents a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial family home or two, in one of Kilkenny’s most accessible and community-focused village locations.
